description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Samurai], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Iron Allegiance Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Samurai
description.text: Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Iron Allegiance Mode
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 15/30/50% more damage after using 0/1/2 Samurai abilities, casts Flashfire Slash after using four Samurai abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Flashfire Slash
description.text: 1/1/2 single attacks (6.90/6.90/3.50 each) capped at 99999, 0/50/100% additional critical chance if the user has 0/500/1000 Soul Break points, 100% hit rate
